items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And his name was Gloria Swanson. ... As a matter of fact Gloria Swanson came in to see Gloria Swanson.

ctx.x: Yeah, okay. So they had an entertainer there who was a female impersonator, a big, black guy who wore a dress. And his name was Gloria Swanson. Like Hi-Fi White.
